description.value:
Prerequisites: White Mage 10

In her quest for self-perfection, the white mage has discovered a way to further enhance herself and others. When an enhancing spell the white mage casts grants an enhancement bonus to an ability score, that bonus increases by 2. At 20th level, the bonus increases by 4.

Asterisk talent: only one such talent's effect may be applied to an individual spell; decision made before casting.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
